scripts.test:compile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('test-lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project test/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:compile && npm run test:unit:run
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:compile && npm run test:integration:run
scripts.test:all: npm run test:compile && npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:integration:run
scripts.seed:compile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('tools-lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.seed:content: npm run seed:compile && npm run seed:content:run --
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project volrik-pet-care-platform --only functions
